name: Running, Outdoor
instructions: Find a flat road, path, or track and begin at an easy, sustainable pace. Keep your posture upright, relax your shoulders, and let your arms swing naturally at your sides.

Land midfoot beneath your hips rather than reaching out with your stride, and maintain a steady breathing rhythm. Adjust pace to terrain and weather, and increase distance or speed gradually over time.
Outdoor running has more variable terrain and wind resistance than a treadmill. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories running outdoors for 30 minutes at a moderate pace.
